market_summary: Chips led again: the SOX rose 2.8% Monday and another 1.7% at Tuesday's open after a $63B bank-and-Blackstone package to fund Broadcom gear for Anthropic, and Nvidia said it will put $3B into Meta's upsized stock sale. Monday closed with the S&P 500 up 0.7% to 7,677 and the Nasdaq up 0.8%; Tuesday Asia followed, with the Kospi up 3.8% and the Nikkei up 1.7%, and the S&P opened up 0.3%. The 10-yr yield sits near 5.0%, Brent eased to around $115, September durable goods rose 1.8% (1.7% expected), and futures price only about a 10% chance of a Fed hike this week. Micron's Taoyuan union talks ended with no deal and a third round set for Nov 6, so no new strike yet. Next: Enphase and Robinhood results ~7am AEDT Wed, SK hynix results Wed, Apple Mac event 4am AEDT Thu, Fed decision 5am AEDT Thu, Alphabet ~7am AEDT Thu, Amazon/Axos/Rocket ~7am AEDT Fri.

AMZN.reason: Up 1% since Monday's early read. Anthropic's S-1 shows a $110B AWS commitment through 2036 and 48% of its revenue running through cloud marketplaces. Results Friday AEDT.

AXOS.reason: Flat, down 0.5% since Monday. No news. Results Thursday after close, ~7am AEDT Friday.

BABA.reason: Flat Monday and Tuesday, down 4% since Oct 21. China's September industrial profits rose 14.4%, but nothing company-specific yet.

ENPH.reason: Down 4% Monday ahead of Q3 results tonight. Consensus has sales down about 26% year on year. The guide decides the next move.

FIGR.reason: Down 5.5% Monday and 12% since Oct 21 with no company news. Results due Nov 12. Watch for further slide.

GOOGL.reason: Down 1% Monday as comm services lagged. Anthropic has committed at least $114.5B to Google cloud through 2033. Results Thursday 7am AEDT.

LDI.reason: Flat since Monday, no news. Mortgage rates still tied to a 10-yr yield near 5%.

META.reason: Down 2% Monday and 11% since Oct 21 on dilution. Nvidia is taking $3B of the upsized $37.5B raise and Meta is adding Vera Rubin capacity.

MRVL.reason: Up 2% Monday and 2% more Tuesday as the $63B Broadcom-Anthropic financing lifted custom-silicon peers. Up 4% since the last run.

MU.reason: Up 3% Monday and 1.5% Tuesday. Taoyuan union talks ended with no deal, next round Nov 6, no new strike called. SK hynix reports Wednesday.

NFLX.reason: Down 3% Monday as the ad-revenue cut and a weak Q4 guide drew downgrades. Down 2% since the last run.

NVDA.reason: Up 2.4% Monday and 1% Tuesday. It is investing $3B in Meta's stock sale, which some read as circular financing, and Meta is expanding Vera Rubin deployment.

RKT.reason: Down 1.6% since Monday with a 10-yr yield near 5%. Results Thursday after close, ~7am AEDT Friday.

TSM.reason: Up 1.4% Monday and 1.3% Tuesday with the chip rebound. Anthropic and Meta compute deals all run through its fabs.

STRIPE.reason: No new priced round. Mark unchanged.

OPENAI.reason: The $30B round at $1.25T pre-money is reportedly near, but no close has been confirmed. Mark unchanged until it closes.

headlines: Chips rallied a second day on a $63B bank-and-Blackstone package for Anthropic's Broadcom chips; SOX up 2.8% Monday, 1.7% Tuesday.
Nvidia is putting $3B into Meta's stock raise, now $37.5B; Meta is down 11% since Oct 21 on dilution.
Celestica upgraded to accumulate/high: Q3 revenue up 83% and a first 2027 outlook of $40B, up 90%.
Micron's Taoyuan union talks ended without a deal; next round Nov 6, no new strike called.
Next, AEDT: Enphase and Robinhood ~7am Wed; Fed 5am Thu; Alphabet ~7am Thu; Amazon, Axos, Rocket ~7am Fri.
